title: Identification of Nogo-B as a potential therapeutic target of osteosarcoma via stereochemically selective covalent probes.
authors: Xue, Jian; Li, Meng; Kang, Li; Wang, Meiting; Yin, Jiabin; Sun, Donghui; Deng, Yaqi; Wei, Qinghua; Wong, Jiemin; Zhu, Tong; Liu, Shunying
one_liner_zh: 该文通过共价小分子探针筛选骨肉瘤药物靶点Nogo-B，核心是药物靶点鉴定与信号通路机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与课题无关。
abstract: Osteosarcoma (OS) has been defined as one of the most intricate and formidable malignant bone tumors, and there has been no significant improvement in targeted therapies for OS over the past 50 years. Therefore, it is crucial to identify new potential drug targets for OS. Here, we have developed a label-free activity-based protein profiling (ABPP) using a stereochemically selective probe from an in-house patrimonial library of covalent small molecule compounds to identify an anti-OS target. Phenotypic screening resulted in the discovery of a selective inhibitor (S,R)-4v that potently suppresses the proliferation of OS 143B cells with an IC(50) value of 0.28 microM. Subsequent label-free ABPP studies identified neurite outgrowth inhibitor B (Nogo-B) as the primary cellular target for (S,R)-4v via a rapid relatively quantitative analysis using its inactive isomer as control. This finding was validated by interaction assays including pull-down, cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), molecular docking and functional studies. Mechanistic investigations revealed that the apoptotic effect induced by (S,R)-4v was mediated through Nogo-B inhibition of the PI3K/AKT-dependent NF-kappaB pathway. Altogether, this study presents a novel strategy that couples anti-OS compound screening with target identification and successfully identifies Nogo-B as a potential candidate for targeted OS therapy.
abstract_zh: 骨肉瘤（Osteosarcoma, OS）已被定义为最复杂且难治的恶性骨肿瘤之一，过去50年中针对OS的靶向治疗未见显著进展。因此，识别OS新的潜在药物靶点至关重要。在此，我们利用内部共价小分子化合物库中的立体化学选择性探针，开发了一种无标记的活性基蛋白质谱分析（activity-based protein profiling, ABPP）方法，以识别抗OS靶点。通过表型筛选，发现了一种选择性抑制剂(S,R)-4v，其能有效抑制OS 143B细胞的增殖，半数抑制浓度（IC(50)）值为0.28微摩尔。随后的无标记ABPP研究，以其非活性异构体作为对照，通过快速相对定量分析，确定了神经突生长抑制因子B（Nogo-B）为(S,R)-4v的主要细胞靶点。这一发现通过包括pull-down、细胞热位移分析（CETSA）、分子对接及功能研究在内的相互作用实验得到验证。机制研究表明，(S,R)-4v诱导的凋亡效应是通过Nogo-B抑制PI3K/AKT依赖性NF-kappaB通路介导的。总体而言，本研究提出了一种将抗OS化合物筛选与靶点识别相结合的新策略，并成功将Nogo-B确定为OS靶向治疗的潜在候选靶点。
